items.title: When does a new ask actually create a real trade-off?
items.description: Back-derived from the worked scenario: the sprint already carries 4 days of committed work (the billing fix and the migration, 2 days each). Drag the new export feature's size and the sprint's total capacity to see exactly when a real trade-off appears — versus when the request can genuinely be absorbed with no cost at all.
items.compute: const existingLoad = 4; const totalDemand = existingLoad + params.exportFeatureDays; const overflow = Math.max(0, totalDemand - params.sprintCapacityDays); return { overflow };
